_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Live score pinned near 50 inside Complacency band with 0% 30d tape and unbroken range keeps the rung unchanged until flows or fear/greed break the coil.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase but intake decline does not contradict range-bound hold
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed holds 45-55 and BTC stays range-bound with 30d change near 0%
next_move.invalidated_if: range break while ETF flows stay near 0 (down into Anxiety) or sharp ETF-flow reversal plus breakout (up into Disbelief)
